original_task.informal_prefix: /-- Suppose that $f$ is holomorphic in an open set $\Omega$. Prove that if $\text{Im}(f)$ is constant, then $f$ is constant.-/
original_task.formal_statement:
theorem exercise_1_13b {f : ℂ → ℂ} (Ω : Set ℂ) (a b : Ω) (h : IsOpen Ω)
  (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω) (hc : ∃ (c : ℝ), ∀ z ∈ Ω, (f z).im = c) :
  f a = f b :=
original_task.goal:

Ω : Set ℂ
a b : ↑Ω
h : IsOpen Ω
hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω

⊢ f ↑a = f ↑b
